name: GDPR File Existence Checks
description: Verifies existence of essential legal and security files — privacy policy, cookies policy, terms of service, and robots.txt.

items.description: Privacy policy must exist (GDPR Art. 13/14 obligation)
items.regulation: GDPR Art. 13/14 — controller must provide information about processing
items.remediation: Create a privacy.html page with your privacy policy, including data controller identity, purposes, legal basis, and data subject rights.

items.description: Cookies policy / cookie consent page should exist
items.regulation: ePrivacy Directive (2002/58/EC) Art. 5(3) — cookie consent required. Page existence alone does not verify consent mechanism.
items.remediation: Create a cookies.html page explaining cookie usage, types, and how users can manage preferences.

items.description: Terms of service should exist (best practice, E-Commerce Directive)
items.regulation: Best practice — E-Commerce Directive (2000/31/EC) Art. 10 for information society services
items.remediation: Create a terms.html page outlining terms of service, acceptable use, limitations of liability, and governing law.

items.description: robots.txt should exist with appropriate crawl directives
items.regulation: Web standard — not a GDPR requirement. Relevant to website operations and search engine indexing.
items.remediation: Create a robots.txt file in the web root with appropriate Allow/Disallow directives.
